title: Recent Purchasing Addition to the Gift Cards & Store Credit Consolidation Move Limit
content:
Recent purchasing raises the move limit of a Gift Cards & Store Credit consolidation of value carried onto a card by replacement, measured by the points postings for dispatched orders on the holder's Marlowe Rewards membership. The amount is added to the move limit after the move limit's application for the age of the stolen or lost card.

| Earning postings for dispatched orders on the holder's Marlowe Rewards membership in the last 12 months | Added to the move limit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 30.00 |
| At least 3 but fewer than 6 | 15.00 |
| Fewer than 3 | Nothing |

The postings counted are those dated in the last 12 months, that is fewer than 12 whole months before the consolidation date. A holder with no Marlowe Rewards membership has no postings.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical holders)

| Postings in the last 12 months | Added |
|---|---|
| 2 | Nothing |
| 3 | 15.00 |
| 5 | 15.00 |
| 6 | 30.00 |

The addition rests on the count of postings alone, whatever the holder's tier.
